description: TypeScript 5.6+ with --noUncheckedIndexedAccess flags Map.get() as possibly undefined. Explicit nullish coalescing or undefined guarding is required.

fingerprint.errorSignature: TS2532: Object is possibly 'undefined' when accessing Map.get() result property

doNot: Do not use non-null assertion operator (!) blindly on Map lookups
Do not disable strict null checks in tsconfig.json

mutations.description: Bypasses type checker with direct assumption that throws at runtime for missing keys
Hardcodes static return value losing dynamic role lookup
